items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree preferred or any combination of education, Training, or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and ability.
Three years of experience in technical support, technology enablement, or related client-facing technology roles preferred. Higher education experience desirable.

1. Builds and maintains positive relationships with faculty, staff, students, and campus departments, proactively engaging users to understand their technology needs, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
3. Serves as a trusted technology resource, advising users on effective use of CGU-supported systems, identifying practical solutions, and coordinating with other OIT specialists when needed.
4. Promotes technology adoption and user independence through individual and group training, onboarding, knowledge articles, tutorials, self-service resources, and ongoing user engagement.

6. Assists with computer configuration, deployment, maintenance, software upgrades, endpoint management, and asset lifecycle activities, ensuring adherence to institutional technology and security standards.
8. Provides assistance and user guidance for Microsoft 365, Windows, macOS, Canvas, PeopleSoft, email, collaboration platforms, and other CGU-supported applications.
11. Maintains service documentation, contributes to OIT projects and departmental initiatives, and performs other related duties as assigned.
1. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and engage effectively with users of varying technical abilities.
2. Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across Windows, macOS, desktop applications, networking, and peripheral technologies.
3. A proactive, resourceful, and innovative mindset, with demonstrated initiative in identifying and implementing technology or service improvements.
4. Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance, develop user-friendly documentation, and deliver effective individual or group training.
5. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Teams, Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, and enterprise collaboration technologies.
6. Familiarity with higher education technologies, including learning management systems, classroom technologies, and administrative applications.
7. Interest in emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and digital productivity tools, and their practical application to improving user experience and efficiency.
8. Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and handle sensitive information with discretion.
9. Understanding of information security, data privacy, endpoint management, and IT service management practices.
10. Strong customer service orientation, adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
